g.text: Boxes are nodes, thick lines are buses. Everything touching a bus line shares the same physical

g.desc: Boxes are nodes, thick lines are buses. Everything touching a bus line shares the same physical

g.text: wires and is selected by address (I2C) or by CS (SPI); slaves never talk to each other. Dashed

g.text: grey means present in firmware but not fitted on this rig.

g.text: Log stream One-way and best effort: the master clocks 0xFF filler on MOSI, slaves present

g.desc: Log stream One-way and best effort: the master clocks 0xFF filler on MOSI, slaves present

g.text: self-framed packets on MISO. No ack, no time sync, no command set.

g.desc: self-framed packets on MISO. No ack, no time sync, no command set.

g.text: Records TIME (VT_DATETIME, 1 Hz from the DS1307) and LGHT (ADC average, 20 Hz).

g.desc: Records TIME (VT_DATETIME, 1 Hz from the DS1307) and LGHT (ADC average, 20 Hz).

g.text: Rates The slave emits ~470 B/s; the master drains ~125 KB/s in 512-byte blocks.

g.desc: Rates The slave emits ~470 B/s; the master drains ~125 KB/s in 512-byte blocks.

g.text: Ground Two separate builds and two separate power domains. Tie the grounds together.

g.desc: Ground Two separate builds and two separate power domains. Tie the grounds together.

g.text: CS lines Drive every CS high straight after bus init. A floating NSS let the STM32 drive
